projects.name: Bersama Digital Infrastructure Asia joint venture, Jakarta data centers
projects.quote: We acquired a 50% interest in the joint venture, which consists of two land parcels and two buildings in Jakarta, Indonesia for approximately $94.7 million.

projects.name: Blackstone joint venture hyperscale data center campuses (Frankfurt, Paris, Northern Virginia)
projects.quote: The campuses are planned to support the construction of 10 data centers with approximately 500 megawatts of potential IT load capacity.

projects.name: Digital Dulles campus development projects
projects.quote: In April 2025, we contributed an additional three development projects at the Digital Dulles campus to our joint venture with Blackstone.

projects.name: Mitsubishi joint venture, Dallas metro data centers
projects.quote: We contributed the two data center buildings at a contribution value of approximately $261 million.

projects.name: GI Partners joint venture, Chicago hyperscale data center campus third facility
projects.quote: We contributed the data center at a value of approximately $453 million.
